editorial:
Imagine you are stuck in the middle of the Civil War with a bunch of soldiers who just robbed a bank. You think you have hit the jackpot, but then you hide out in an old, creepy plantation house that feels like it wants you dead. You get a strong sense of dread right away because these men are already on edge and fighting with each other. The vibe is heavy and dark, making you feel like something bad is hiding in every shadow of that decaying house. It is a wild mix of a gritty war story and a scary ghost tale that keeps you guessing about what is actually real.

The acting is solid and makes the tension feel real, though the story moves a bit slow in the middle. You will love the creepy atmosphere, but some might find the lack of big jump scares a bit frustrating. If you like movies that creep you out slowly, you should definitely check this one out.
endingExplained: As the tension peaks, you realize the ghosts are feeding on the soldiers' guilt and hate. One by one, the men are picked off by supernatural forces they cannot fight with guns. In the end, the greed and violence they brought into the house lead to their total downfall. Most of the group dies in terror, proving that their crimes caught up with them. It wraps up with a bleak feeling, showing that no one truly wins.
targetAudience: Ideal for anyone who loves ghost stories set in the old west.
